extracted.intended_audience: attorneys/agents seeking reinstatement to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office; USPTO Office of Enrollment and Discipline stakeholders
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluation and decision process for a petition to reinstate an individual to practice before the USPTO (patent bar), based on filings and record material relevant to eligibility under applicable regulations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing a Petition for Reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: Consideration has been given to the Petition for Reinstatement of David E. Herron II, received on February 18, 2020.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A petition must be filed and received by the Office of Enrollment and Discipline for consideration; the receipt date is recorded. The petition itself is the initiating document for reinstatement review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: Mr. Herron has filed an Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58, in support of the Petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An affidavit compliant with 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 must accompany the petition as supporting evidence. The regulation citation indicates a specific statutory/ regulatory form/content requirement for the affidavit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review of Petition, Affidavit, and record information material to eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: After careful review of the Petition, and the supporting Affidavit, and all information in the record material to his eligibility for reinstatement, the Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline has determined that reinstatement ... is appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reinstatement determinations are based on a comprehensive review of the petition, any supporting affidavits, and all record information material to eligibility. The decision-maker (Director, OED) exercises discretion after reviewing these materials to determine whether reinstatement is appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authority to grant reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: The Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline has determined that reinstatement ... is appropriate. Accordingly, the Petition is hereby GRANTED.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Director (Deputy General Counsel for Enrollment and Discipline and Director of OED) has authority to grant or deny reinstatement petitions based on the review. A formal written decision is issued and served (copy to the petitioner).
